title: Story Flow Engine
description: A narrative flow engine for managing branching storylines and interactive storytelling experiences.
longDescription: Story Flow Engine is a TypeScript-based narrative engine that enables developers to create complex branching storylines with state management, conditional paths, and dynamic content generation. Built with a focus on extensibility and developer experience.

title: OpenCode Setup
description: Configuration toolkit for OpenCode AI coding assistant with orchestration models, quality gates, and domain subagents.
longDescription: A comprehensive configuration and setup toolkit for OpenCode, the AI coding assistant. Includes orchestration models, quality gates, domain-specific subagent routing, and bootstrap scripts for repository configuration.

title: EndToEndLabCR Documentation
description: Comprehensive tech documentation platform for knowledge transfer and learning, built with Markdown and modern static site generation.
longDescription: A complete documentation platform serving as a knowledge base for EndToEndLabCR's educational initiatives. Covers web development, software engineering best practices, and hands-on tutorials for knowledge transfer sessions.

title: KT Session Templates
description: Starter templates and boilerplate projects for Knowledge Transfer sessions covering React, TypeScript, and modern web development.
longDescription: A collection of starter templates designed for EndToEndLabCR's Knowledge Transfer sessions. Each template provides a solid foundation for learning specific technologies with progressive complexity and real-world examples.

title: NaranjoSolutions Client Work
description: Freelance software development projects including web applications, automation tools, and technical consulting.
longDescription: Emerging freelance portfolio under NaranjoSolutions, delivering custom software solutions for clients across various industries. Focused on modern web technologies and clean, maintainable code.
